item.tib: byams ma chen mo skyon gyi 'jigs skyob ma'i dkyil chog khrus kyi rgya mtsho
item.coloph: ces byams ma skyon gyi 'jigs skyob ma'i dkyil chog khrus kyi rgya mtsho 'di yang / mkhan zur nyi ri sher bzhin gyis 'di ltar bris shig gsungs pa'i lung gnang / gong gi mdzad byang byams ma dkyil chog so so gnad kyi gsal byed la gzhi byas te/ skam rigs kyi btsun pa rnam rgyal tshul khrims kyis/ bya dur gnam mthongs su 'phel phyogs dga' ba'i nyin brtsams pa dge legs su gyur cig/
